tools.name: book2skill
tools.does: Books or manuals you own, or public-domain texts, into a tested Agent Skill, one stage per call (extract, split, index, build, audit, eval, refresh, export) with a receipt per stage and an eval gate of 0.6 that refuses export; pass local files, not URLs

args.name: stage
args.does: extract | split | index | build | audit | eval | refresh | export

args.name: src
args.does: extract: the source file you own (PDF, EPUB, DOCX, MD, TXT)

args.name: work
args.does: work dir, e.g. work/mybook (every stage except audit)

args.name: skill
args.does: skill dir, e.g. skills/mybook (build, audit, eval, export)

args.name: name
args.does: build: skill name, a-z0-9- and equal to the skill dir name

args.name: description
args.does: build: what the skill does and when to use it

args.name: qa
args.does: eval: the question file, e.g. evals/mybook_qa.jsonl

args.name: target
args.does: export: claude | codex | opencode | gemini

args.name: out
args.does: extract: the work dir to write; export: the output dir

for: autonomous-factory: packs for sale (skillworks finish bar S3)
Maxim's job work: a manual or doc into a tested skill
center skill doctor (skillworks bars S1, S2)

tools.name: part_score
tools.does: One live line per part of skillworks (P1 pipeline, P2 MCP server, P3 seeds, P4 eval gate, P5 shop, workspace) from receipts, eval rates and a local MCP handshake; read-only, no arguments
for: center kernel Grow rule 'Parts' (is skillworks getting better)

tools.name: cron_skip_clean
tools.does: Skip a run when nothing changed: fingerprints a directory, prints SKIP clean <id> when it matches the state file, else writes the state JSON and prints RUN <id>; no network

args.name: watch
args.does: directory to fingerprint

args.name: state
args.does: state file to read and write (JSON), e.g. state/watch.json

for: every loop repo: skip the round when the inputs did not change (saves tokens)
center

tools.name: pipe_dry_run
tools.does: Plan a batch before spending: reads every .txt in a directory, estimates tokens (chars // 4 each) against a cap and prints DRY-RUN <n> items spend <t> tokens (cap <c>); writes nothing

args.name: input
args.does: directory of .txt items

args.name: out
args.does: output directory the real run would use (not created in a dry run)

args.name: cap
args.does: maximum tokens of spend, an integer

for: factory batch runs: know the cost before a run
every loop repo

tools.name: adopted_after
tools.does: Fills the after column of the skill doctor's adopted.csv when a row is 48 hours past its install and the repo's loop really ran through the window (shell calls in 36 of 48 hours, at least half the before workload), scaled to the before workload; --status says what each row waits for, --dry-run writes nothing; reads the OpenCode history read-only and center's empire.json
for: center skill doctor and installer: after numbers without a hand-run scan
skillworks finish bar S5

tools.name: fleet_failures
tools.does: Doctor lane eyes: top failure classes of the fleet from the OpenCode history read-only (scan), skill loads by skill and repo sharing one counter with S1 and S2 (loads), before and now for one skill (compare), lane tokens that move only on new work (lanes), one ROUND line (round-line); writes only to the skill-doctor state folder

args.name: command
args.does: scan | loads | compare | lanes | round-line

args.name: skill
args.does: compare: the skill name, e.g. pwsh-for-bash-writers

args.name: hours
args.does: scan, loads: window in hours (default 48, 24)

args.name: db
args.does: opencode.db path (default OPENCODE_DB or the local share file, always opened read-only)

for: center skill doctor: the first patient comes from its output
skillworks finish bars S1, S2 (loads shares one counter)

tools.name: pack_check
tools.does: Gate for a skill pack that is for sale: pack.json and licences (a NonCommercial skill is never in a priced pack), each skill's format, eval gate and live proof, the listing's fields, price and proof lines, the buyer zip (current, safe paths, manifest sha256, one zip per skill with SKILL.md at the root), the free Vol 0 zip, the price evidence pages, and the store assets still needed; prints PASS, FAIL, WARN and NEEDS lines and one RESULT line, exit 0 only on PASS; reads this repo and the evidence pages, writes nothing

args.name: pack
args.does: pack folder, e.g. packs/fleet-vol-1 (build its zips first with python tools/pack_build.py)

for: factory F6: the buyer-file gate for a skillworks pack before it is listed
skillworks finish bar S3

tools.name: skill_lint
tools.does: Distill kit gate for a book-to-skill skill: plan groups work/chunks into reading packets of at most 6000 tokens with chunk locators; check refuses scaffold text, rules without locators, fewer than 10 tested pairs or trials, an SKILL.md body over 2000 tokens, and non-ASCII; exit 1 on any finding

args.name: skill
args.does: skill dir, e.g. skills/mybook

args.name: work
args.does: work dir whose chunks locators must resolve to

for: cure smith: the first skill must pass it before it ships
book smith: distill plan packets for the reading pass
judge: one-number distill gate

tools.name: skill_trial
tools.does: Stranger-run trial gate for a skill: sheet prints the task sheet from evals/NAME_trials.jsonl (task text only, grading keys hidden) so a stranger runs it cold; grade scores work/trials/NAME/with.jsonl against without.jsonl by code (must present, must_not absent, run tasks need run output with the expected exit) and writes skills/NAME/references/trial-proof.json with runs, with_rate, without_rate, lift, spread and fingerprint; exit 0 only on 10 or more runs, with_rate 0.8 or more and lift 0.3 or more

args.name: skill
args.does: skill name, e.g. pipe-run

args.name: trials
args.does: trials dir holding with.jsonl and without.jsonl (default work/trials/NAME/)

for: installer: the stranger run of a new skill, 12 tasks
judge: one-number trial gate
skillworks finish bar S6

tools.name: extract_clean
tools.does: Clean extract of a PDF, EPUB or DOCX you own: markitdown engine keeps headings, pipe tables and fenced code (classic engine is the plain-text fallback); prints chars, kind, engine and heading/table/fence counts

args.name: src
args.does: the source file you own (PDF, EPUB, DOCX)

args.name: out
args.does: work dir, e.g. work/mybook

for: book smith: the first extract keeps headings, tables and code fences
judge: structure counts per extract

tools.name: edit_guard
tools.does: Refuse a stale edit before it fails: checks a literal oldString (--old-file or stdin) is present exactly in a target file; on a miss exits 1 quoting the re-read rule and prints the closest lines with tabs as \t and CRLF as \r; writes nothing

args.name: file
args.does: target file to check the oldString against

args.name: old_string
args.does: literal oldString on the command line (else --old-file or stdin)

args.name: old_file
args.does: file holding the literal oldString

for: every seat: re-read precisely before editing CRLF files (top failed call: edit oldString not found)

tools.name: skill_registry
tools.does: Pinned skill installer: freeze writes manifest (skills with versions) plus lock (per-file sha256 plus repo HEAD source pin); install converges a dir from the lock (--check exits 1 on any diff); registry writes registry.json (eval_rate plus source pin per skill) and validate checks it; offline, stdlib only

args.name: skills
args.does: skills dir to freeze, e.g. skills

args.name: manifest
args.does: manifest file to write, e.g. manifest.json

args.name: lock
args.does: lock file to write (freeze) or read (install)

for: installer: one repo installs from the lock with an empty diff (skillworks finish bar R3)
judge: registry validates
